title: Hiring of services for NDT testing and 3D Laser Scanning of inter-connecting bridges at BHS, ICP, SH, NQO, MHN, NEELAM, HEERA and TAPTI process complexes of Western Offshore
tendering_authority: Tender247 (likely for an Oil & Gas PSU like ONGC)
scope_summary: This tender seeks services for Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) and 3D laser scanning of inter-connecting bridges located at various process complexes in the Western Offshore region. The services are crucial for assessing the integrity and dimensional accuracy of critical infrastructure in an offshore oil and gas environment.

title: GIS BASED INTEGRATED AIRPORT ASSET MANAGEMENT SYSTEM at Cochin International Airport (including 6 years AMC)
scope_summary: This tender is for the selection of a bidder to implement an integrated GIS-based asset management platform for Cochin International Airport Limited (CIAL). The scope includes comprehensive data acquisition, processing, modeling, system integration, application development, deployment, training, and long-term support for 96 months, with 6 years of AMC.

title: Tender Invited For Artificial Intelligence Enabled Condition Based Monitoring and Predictive Maintenance of AFV Engines Quantity: 1
tendering_authority: Government e-Marketplace (GeM) for an unknown Security Services entity
